subject: [PATCH v2 1/4] mm: zswap: fix shrinker count for the root memcg

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the zswap shrinker that causes it to incorrectly report the number of freeable entries for the root memory cgroup (memcg). The issue arises because the memcg's compression ratio is calculated from stats that do not include the root memcg's own entries. As a result, when the root memcg has no descendants with zswap entries, the shrinker reports nothing to reclaim, and its entries are never written back. To fix this, the patch uses the pool-wide counters for the root memcg instead of its stats, ensuring that all zswap entries are accounted for. This change also eliminates the need to flush the root memcg's stats, which was previously required.
